item.title: Utah judge rejects defense's motion to disqualify prosecutors in the Charlie Kirk killing case
item.description: SALT LAKE CITY (AP) — A Utah judge on Tuesday declined to disqualify the local county attorney’s office from prosecuting the accused shooter in Charlie Kirk's killing after the defense argued there was a conflict of interest because a prosecutor's daughter was present when Kirk was shot.
